summary: OceanaGold Corp filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its second quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a routine announcement of scheduled financial results and an associated investor conference call. The registrant is a foreign private issuer, and this filing is the equivalent of an ordinary earnings release notification reportable on Form 6-K under US securities laws.
